warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 4.00 (7.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 2.50 + 1.10 + 2.00 + 0.90 (6.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04. Vector CAD PDF; values read off rendered crops.

Truss elevations (S-05) print panel chains against the grid markers; per section 4 rule 4 every tick became a line. T1: 0.83 x3 = 2.49 against the printed 2.50 (A-B) and 2.49 against 2.50 (B'' to D); inner ticks are positioned off the upper line, the 0.01 closure absorbed by the last segment. T4: 0.93 x4 + 0.30 = 4.02 against the printed total 4.00 (B-E); ticks positioned from B' downward, the 0.02 excess absorbed by the last segment (C''''' to E = 0.91, printed 0.93).

C''''' (5.59, Truss T4) and D (5.60) are 0.01 apart and are probably the same point drawn twice; kept both per section 4 rule 4 (compare to the millimetre). B'' (3.10, from B + 0.30 + 0.30) is the same tick the T1 0.83-chain reaches from D (5.60 - 2.49 = 3.11); one line, positioned from B.

x 2''' (5.00) is the 2.00 + 2.00 split printed on S-01..S-04 - the S-02 beam B1 between the PS and S2 panels and truss T4 sit on it. It is 2''' (not 2') because the T3/T2 panel ticks at 4.00 and 4.41 come before it in the same gap (dummy names follow position order, section 4).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-07). ระดับหลังอกไก่ is printed twice (+5.14 and +5.61, chain 1.17 + 0.46); the value is kept in each id so the two stay distinct. ระดับดินเดิม (S-06) prints no value. Truss depths (T1 1.78, T2 1.32, T3 1.66, T4 0.69 + 0.50 = 1.19) stay on the truss elements.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-06 plus A-07 รูปตัด A (levels). Other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03..A-06, A-08..A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-06..S-08 print only member-internal dimensions, which stay on their elements. A-10 (door/window schedule) prints only opening sizes and sill/head heights from ระดับพื้นห้อง, which stay on the schedule elements.
